limitations: This is entry verification only. No retained-test measurement, inference, launch, preparation, resource probe, statistics-worker, export-worker or audit-all action was executed; no future numerical result is certified.

Same-day/later-processing and direct-export repairs were verified from independently parsed static source/control flow, not by changing the clock, fabricating a TEST_REPORT, or dynamically invoking processing/export actions.

Confirmation relative-error arithmetic was checked using bound reported point values; this entry review does not duplicate the historical independent raw-row/model reconstruction or bootstrap endpoint audit.

The report depends on the inspected SHA256 fingerprints and current zero-test-evidence snapshot. Future file changes invalidate the entry binding. A full independent raw-row/metric audit remains mandatory after test measurement.
The documented check and reviewer SHA256 work read metadata and JPEG bytes but do not benchmark service times. Successful CPU witness is not a global guarantee against native library/runtime failure.

Historical limitations remain: same-day single-machine/two-CPU-profile evidence, sparse cells, point-estimate acceptance only, bootstrap intervals of measured distributions rather than prediction error, and incomplete reproduction of the original OpenMP failure.
No per-cell accuracy, real deployment generalization, queue/simulator validity, vision accuracy, QLA benefit, model training or paper authorization is implied.
